clauses.heading: Section 6. Early termination
clauses.text:
Section 6. Early termination
Tenant may end this lease before the end of the term by giving sixty (60) days written notice and paying an early termination fee equal to two (2) months' rent.

clauses.heading: Section 5. End of term and notice to vacate
clauses.text:
Section 5. End of term and notice to vacate
Tenant must give Landlord written notice of intent to vacate at least sixty (60) days before the end of the lease term.
If Tenant does not give this notice, the lease renews on a month-to-month basis at a monthly rent of $1,950.00.

Maple Court Apartments
Residential Lease Agreement
Landlord: Maple Court Apartments LLC
Tenant: Alex Sample
Premises: 1200 Maple Court Way, Unit 4B, Springfield
Lease term: January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 (12 months).
Monthly rent: $1,850.00, due on the 1st day of each month.
Late fee: If rent is not received by the 5th day of the month, Tenant will pay a late fee of $75.00.
Landlord contact: Maple Court Management Office, 1-800-555-0119, office@maple-court.example
